UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user preferences and profile metadata stored under their UID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Optional email address of the user.

preferredMode.description: Active or default AgentMode enum key.

hinglishPreferred.description: Whether quick Hinglish/Hindi bilingual preference is toggled on.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A saved AI chat thread owned by an authenticated user.

title.description: Conversation title derived from the first user message.

agentMode.description: AgentMode enum key used in the conversation.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview snippet of the latest message.

messageCount.description: Number of messages in the conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual user or AI model message within a conversation.

agentMode.description: AgentMode enum key active for this message.

thinkingSteps.description: Bounded list of agent thinking phase strings.

followUpSuggestions.description: Bounded list of clickable follow-up prompt suggestions.

attachmentLabel.description: Optional attachment filename or photo label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and preferences scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Saved conversation threads owned by the authenticated user.
Chronological chat messages inside a user conversation.
